correctness.rationale: The coordinate sections are fixed-point sets of reflection isometries and hence totally geodesic. Differentiating the perimeter integral gives gradient (π,π); the uniform Taylor remainder gives the pair-sum linearization. The inverse pair-sum map has exact l-infinity norm 3/2, and the explicit perturbation direction attains it, proving both the upper bound and sharpness of 3/(2π).
